00233                                 @param table    A single channel Buffer used as a lookup table. Here an input           \
00234                                                 value of inLow would output the first value in the table, an            \
00235                                                 input value of inHigh would output the last value in the table.         \
00236                                                 An input value half way between inLow and inHigh would output the       \
00237                                                 value in the middle of the table, and so on.
